title: Mikayla Nogueira’s POV Beauty secures $15 million investment to accelerate its Sephora momentum
summary: The Series A funding round led by Silas Capital, will be used to accelerate momentum within beauty retailer Sephora and improve the skin care brand’s presence on TikTok Shop
